axes: glTF/three.js metres, +y up. An item's origin is its floor-contact centre and its front faces +z at yaw 0, the manifest's actor-facing convention: a furniture anchor's yaw turns an item as an actor's facing turns an avatar.

aeron.label: Aeron with headrest
aeron.provenance: Original procedural ergonomic chair geometry after the Aeron silhouette; no downloaded mesh or texture. Carbon default, Mineral alternative.

cast-iron-pan.label: Large cast-iron wrist-training pan
cast-iron-pan.provenance: Original 40 cm seasoned cast-iron pan with 25 cm integral handle, helper loop and generated sand-cast normal texture; used by the pan-raise activity.

dining-chair.label: Oak and woven-cord dining chair
dining-chair.provenance: Original bent-oak chair with woven cord and forked back after the Danish wishbone tradition; all six instances share these exported resources.

dining-table.label: Travertine dining table
dining-table.provenance: Original 2.2 by 1 metre rounded travertine table with smoked-oak trestles and brass foot rails.

dumbbell.label: Rubber hex dumbbell
dumbbell.provenance: Original rubber hex-ended dumbbell and nickel grip; reused for the gym rack pair.

eames-lounge.label: Eames lounge chair and ottoman
eames-lounge.provenance: Original Blender geometry after the Eames Lounge Chair and Ottoman (Herman Miller): published dimensions and a measured reference from Sirui's configurator download, whose terms do not allow redistribution; nothing from the download is shipped.

floating-fireplace.label: Suspended UFO fireplace
floating-fireplace.provenance: Original suspended graphite fireplace with open combustion bowl and canopy; its 10 cm radius neck reaches 2.20 m above the pit floor to meet the native room flue. Runtime fire uses deterministic bounded flame geometry and a still reduced-motion state.

glass-fridge.label: Glass-door refrigerator
glass-fridge.provenance: Original nickel-framed glass refrigerator with visible shelves, bottles and warm interior strips. Glass blends without depth writes at runtime.

italian-range.label: Italian enamel range
italian-range.provenance: Original 120 cm Italian-inspired range with six burners, twin ovens, enamel, brass controls and nickel trim; no third-party geometry.

pot-filler.label: Swing-arm pot filler
pot-filler.provenance: Original jointed nickel pot filler with articulated swing pivot; no third-party geometry.

range-hood.label: Plaster range hood
range-hood.provenance: Original rounded plaster extraction hood and fitted nickel filter, matching the range's frame.
